edits.headline: Iran keeps Strait of Hormuz closed over US blockade
edits.subheadline: The Revolutionary Guards said the strait would stay closed until the US lifted its blockade of Iranian ports, Al Jazeera reported.
editorialBody: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on 18 April that the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until the US lifted its blockade of Iranian ports, Al Jazeera reported.

Iranian President Pezeshkian stressed the importance of diplomacy but said distrust of and vigilance towards Washington were an "undeniable necessity", Reuters reported, citing the state news agency IRNA.

The South China Morning Post reported that the Strait of Malacca was at risk of a "chain reaction" from Hormuz after a warning by an Iranian adviser. In a separate report, the paper asked why Vietnam and the Philippines trusted Japan when Indonesia did not.
Pfizer and Amgen were among 22 strategic companies planning to open or expand operations in Hong Kong, the South China Morning Post reported, citing a source.
China's silver imports rose to a record in March on demand from retail buyers and solar manufacturers, Bloomberg reported.

In India, the Tamil Nadu Congress chief K Selvaperunthagai said Income Tax officials had "unlawfully confined" him at his home under the pretext of a "search" as Rahul Gandhi arrived in the state to campaign, Scroll.in reported.
